about: Who the 500M-songs board on /records/africas-biggest reads, and how each song's credit is filed. Hand-kept: scripts/build-african-500m.mjs fetches each artist's kworb.net songs page into african500m.snapshot.json, and app/data/african500m.ts counts, ranks and words the board from the two files. An artist with no song past the threshold reads zero and is left off the board; they are here so a song crossing the line joins it on the next refresh. African = by nationality and where the career sits (Paul, 17 Sep 2026). `roles` files a song lead or featured by ChartMasters' rule (lead when the song is on one of the artist's own releases, or the artist is billed first), read from ~/burnaboy-work/roles/cm-rule/<slug>-classified.json on 7 Oct 2026 — the site's Rule C (app/data/songRoles.ts), which tests/african500m.test.tsx holds these filings to wherever both list a song; a song with no entry falls back to kworb's own mark (a '*' row, where the artist is not billed first, is featured). `page` and `tracks` read an artist off another artist's page when kworb has none of their own.

artists.name: Ayra Starr
artists.note: Born in Cotonou, Benin; Nigerian national with a Lagos-based career.

artists.name: Freshlyground
artists.note: Cape Town band. kworb has no songs page for Freshlyground (404), so their one song is read off Shakira's page by its track id; kworb's track page credits it Shakira, Freshlyground.

artists.name: Seether
artists.note: Band formed in Pretoria, US-based since 2002; counted as South African on this page's Hot 100 boards too.

artists.name: Moliy
artists.note: Counted as Ghanaian, as this page's Hot 100 boards count her (hot100Weeks.ts) and its YouTube board lists her. Born 4 Oct 2001 in Accra and raised there; Wikipedia calls her Ghanaian-American.

artists.name: Amaarae
artists.note: Counted as Ghanaian, as this page's Hot 100 boards count her (hot100Weeks.ts) — a closer call than Moliy. Born in the Bronx; raised between Atlanta, New Jersey and Accra; her career was built in Accra's alté scene before Interscope.

artists.name: Libianca
artists.note: Counted as Cameroonian, as this page's Hot 100 boards count her (hot100Weeks.ts). Born in Minneapolis, raised in Bamenda, Cameroon from about age 4; holds both citizenships.

excluded.name: French Montana
excluded.reason: American, as this page's Hot 100 boards have him (hot100NotCounted in hot100Weeks.ts); the closest call, so the board's source names him. Born in Rabat, raised in Morocco until 13, US citizen since 2018, US career.

excluded.name: Troye Sivan
